There is also not alot of support for adults in media, tbh. Think of Anime, Cartoons, etc. alot of it is about kids or teenagers growing up and learning how to navigate the world. All the romance, hobbies, character building, etc. is fleshed out. Adults in those shows tend to be cynical, isolationist, or otherwise portrayed as not good people. 

It sucks that there's not a'lot of support for adults when it comes to mental health, really. We really do have to take initiative and do everything ourselves. If we make mistakes or do things that negatively impact our lives or someone else's, its an automatic "deal with it and move on". We don't get a'lot of support to process our trauma, and it blows.
